capabilities: Author agents as Markdown notes with frontmatter, prompts and wikilink connections
Chat 1:1 and inline via @mentions that answer as callouts in notes
Approve or reject agent-proposed note creations and edits with diff previews
Run squad pipelines and multi-agent brainstorms that synthesize into notes
Generate Obsidian canvas mind-maps from an @mention topic
extras: Full documentation lives in docs/GUIDE.md rather than the README; API keys are stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault, which the README warns not to commit to public backups.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to run AI agents grounded in vault notes, with multi-agent workflows and user approval before any file is written.

relations.evidence: install BRAT (Obsidian42-BRAT), run BRAT: Add a beta plugin

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, NVIDIA NIM, OpenRouter, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

summary: Multi-agent AI framework where agents are Markdown notes in your vault that chat, propose note edits behind approval gates, and brainstorm in a spatial office view.
